# SecondBrain

> SecondBrain is the AI second brain app for your phone. You speak once and it remembers — turning your voice into organized notes, calendar events and follow-ups — and gives your AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor) a single shared long-term memory via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Free on iPhone and Android; the shared memory layer is a Pro feature. Private by design: no analytics, no ads, no training on your data.

## Site

- [Home](https://secondbrain.icu/): What SecondBrain does — voice capture, automatic notes/calendar/follow-ups, and memory shared across every AI you use.
- [How it works (video)](https://secondbrain.icu/#video): A 3-minute demo, "This AI has INFINITE Memory. Here's how to use it." — voice capture to structured note, recall by asking, and one memory shared across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
- [FAQ](https://secondbrain.icu/#faq): What a second brain app is, whether SecondBrain is free, how shared memory works across ChatGPT and Claude, how to connect it, supported devices, privacy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://secondbrain.icu/#privacy): No analytics, no ads, no training; encrypted, isolated per user; delete anytime.
- [Terms of Use](https://secondbrain.icu/#terms)
- [Support](https://secondbrain.icu/#support)

## Connect to an AI assistant

- Claude: add the marketplace `fed3c3sa/secondbrain-shared-memory`, install the SecondBrain plugin, then Connect and sign in with Apple or Google.
- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add fed3c3sa/secondbrain-shared-memory`, then `/plugin install secondbrain@secondbrain`, then `/mcp` and sign in.
- ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor: run `npx secondbrain-connect` once and sign in in the browser.
